map.name: Varrok
map.setting: a castle town with a garrison
map.trouble: The Ogre chieftain Grukk and his Ogres hold the old fort at the Stone Bridge east of Varrok, and no wagon reaches the castle.

guard_bark.specifics: Bolk guards the east postern, barred until Warden Grisholm gives the player leave to cross to the Stone Bridge.

first.speaker: Bolk
first.text: Absolutely not! Off with you, ruffian!

later.speaker: Bolk
later.text:
Stop where you are, stranger! Warden Grisholm says you have leave to pass, and his seal proves it.

Go on! I've unbarred the gate and oiled the hinges just for you.

Will you be back by nightfall, stranger?

bounty_offer.specifics: Gessa's bathhouse is ruined because a gang of Rogues from the old quarry steals all her soap and towels every night.

offer.speaker: Gessa
offer.text:
Thieves! Thieves in my bathhouse!

Every night a gang of Rogues creeps in and carries off all my soap and towels. Those miserable rascals will be the ruin of me! The soldiers stink to high heaven, and nobody pays for a bath without soap!

The Rogues hide out in the old quarry west of town. Run them off for good and I'll pay you handsomely.

reminder.speaker: Gessa
reminder.text: It is high time you got moving, lad, those Rogues get bolder every night.

completion.speaker: Gessa
completion.text:
Gone? The Rogues are really gone?! Oh, happy day! Tonight every soldier in Varrok gets a proper bath!

Here's 100 gold, as promised. You've saved my business, brave Adventurer!

heirloom_fetch.specifics: An Urchin Shaman turned Pruett's husband into a goat, and the Urchins stole the moonstone amulet that could break the curse.

offer.speaker: Pruett
offer.text:
Please, kind sir, you must help me! It's the most horrible thing!

An Urchin Shaman put a curse on my husband, and now he's a goat! A goat! He's chewed up half the laundry already.

I could break the spell with my moonstone amulet, but the Urchins stole it off my windowsill and ran off to their caves north of the castle. Will you bring back my amulet? I'll reward you, I promise.

refusal.speaker: Pruett
refusal.text: You haven't the heart for it. Come back when you've found some.

reminder.speaker: Pruett
reminder.text: Now that you've promised, you'd better hurry back with my amulet!

completion.speaker: Pruett
completion.text:
My amulet! Oh, bless you!

There... the curse is broken! He's my husband again! Oh, thank you, thank you! Here, take this shield. It's the least I can do.

journal.text: Fetch Pruett's amulet from the Urchin caves.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Fetch Pruett's amulet from the Urchin caves.

rumour.specifics: A soldier of the garrison, Lissa, and Pellam, who has lost his cart.

rumour1.speaker: Soldier
rumour1.text: Find that Grukk and knock his ugly head clean off!

rumour2.speaker: Lissa
rumour2.text: You've only just come to Varrok, haven't you? Pity you're not one of the garrison. I just adore soldiers!

rumour3.speaker: Pellam
rumour3.text: Did you see where my cart went? It couldn't have just rolled off by itself!

shop_greeting.specifics: Tibbet keeps the inn, Brask the forge, Quillon the magic shop.

inn.speaker: Tibbet
inn.text: Maybe you'd like a hot supper, or a bed for the night?

arms.speaker: Brask
arms.text: What brings you to my forge, stranger? I've no time to waste.

magic.speaker: Quillon
magic.text: I just know we're going to be wonderful friends! Assuming, of course, you spend lots of gold here!

two_givers.specifics: Quartermaster Brenik wants the garrison's pay chest back from the Ogre camp; Pogg wants his partner Lunk, who went first after the chest, or at least the purse Lunk took with him.

offer_a.speaker: Brenik
offer_a.text:
Good day. You look capable enough.

Grukk's Ogres ambushed our supply wagon on the south road and carried off the garrison's pay chest. The men have gone unpaid for weeks and are on the verge of mutiny!

The chest is in the Ogre camp in the south woods. Return it intact and the armory will see you properly equipped.

offer_b.speaker: Pogg
offer_b.text:
Hey! Hey, you! You going after the Quartermaster's chest? Ha! Too late. Lunk beat you to it.

Lunk's my partner. He went off to that Ogre camp to grab the chest for himself, and he hasn't come back. And he's got my purse with him!

Bring Lunk back. Or, if the Ogres ate him, bring back my purse. Either way you'll get your share.

outcome_a.speaker: Brenik
outcome_a.text:
The pay chest, and still locked! Most excellent! The men will be paid tonight.

Take this Longsword from the armory, with the thanks of the garrison.

outcome_b.speaker: Pogg
outcome_b.text:
My purse! Ha ha! Every coin still in it!

Lunk? Oh, he'll turn up somewhere. Here, take your share.

journal_a.text: Raid the Ogre camp and take back the pay chest.

journal_b.text: Bring Lunk or his purse back from the Ogre camp.

rescue.specifics: Hesk's partner Wobbin keeps sneaking off to sell pots to the Ogres at the Stone Bridge, and they have locked him in a cage again.

plea.speaker: Hesk
plea.text:
Oh, no! Not again! Those Ogres have caught Wobbin again!?

That fool keeps sneaking off to the Stone Bridge to sell pots to the Ogres! And every time they lock him in a cage and keep the pots!

Please, young sir, get him out of there before they throw him in the stew. I'll make it worth your while.

found.speaker: Wobbin
found.text: Drat it all! Now they've gone and smashed my best kettle! I'll try to keep up behind you. Take me to Hesk!

following.speaker: Wobbin
following.text: Whew... looks like I'm not Ogre stew yet. Keep going, friend.

completion.speaker: Hesk
completion.text:
Wobbin! You big oaf, you're home!

Bless you, kind stranger! Please, take this Ankh as a token of my appreciation.

journal.text: Go to the Stone Bridge and free Wobbin from the Ogres.

main_opening.specifics: Pellam sends the player to Warden Grisholm in the Keep; the Warden, an old friend of the patron Dorran, sends him through the east postern to take Grukk's fort at the Stone Bridge.

herald.speaker: Pellam
herald.text: That's it! First they take the bridge then they starve us out. Go see Warden Grisholm in the Keep!

opening.speaker: Grisholm
opening.text:
So, Dorran's friend has finally arrived! Good. We have no time to lose.

That brute Grukk and his Ogres have taken the old fort at the Stone Bridge, east of the castle. Not a single wagon gets through, and my men are down to their last crust of bread! This insolent usurper must be stopped!

I've ordered the east postern unbarred for you. Cross the bridge, take that fort and bring me Grukk's head, lad. Go!

reminder.speaker: Grisholm
reminder.text: It's open! The postern's open! Er... After you.

journal.text: Find a way into Grukk's fort at the Stone Bridge.
